name: Brad
source:
Brad looks like a typical bad boy as a member of the gang, but he actually has a playful character, is good-natured and cares a lot about his friends. Belonging to a group known as the "66", he is well trusted among his fellow gang members. Besides, he is a handyman of the underworld. He does some odd jobs secretly… 

[From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=912279494]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
